en.p: A cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient 9 satisfies the following conditions.

box: (B) The product of the local maximum value and the local minimum value of $f(x)$ is 5.

en.p: The function $g(x)$ satisfies $g(x)=f(x)$ when $0\le x<1$, and $g(x+1)=g(x)$ for every real number $x$. When $g(x)$ is continuous on the set of all real numbers, $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{5}xg(x)\,dx=\frac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
